pkgTitle: Continuing from an earlier solved version
title: Accept ADR 0072: revision-region continuation
body: When an edit to a flowsheet fails to converge, RRC walks the operating values step by step from the nearest earlier version that solved and verified to the new values; every step is a real flowsheet. Measured: it rescued 5 failing edits; the existing restart also rescued all 5, in fewer iterations.
It is opt-in, by the policy name `RRC-revision-v1`.
